user.title: Set up doorbell
user.description: A doorbell combines a doorbell trigger with a camera so that HomeKit recognises both as one video doorbell. The trigger can be a webhook (HTTP call from the LAN) and/or any Home Assistant entity. A mechanical chime can optionally be driven by a switch entity.

data_description.name: Shown as device name and in HomeKit, e.g. "Front door".
data_description.camera_entity: Camera entity whose picture HomeKit shows when the doorbell rings. Each camera can belong to only one doorbell.
data_description.webhook_enabled: The doorbell button calls a Home Assistant webhook URL when pressed (GET or POST, LAN only). The URL is shown in the next step.
data_description.trigger_entities: Binary sensors and input_boolean ring when they turn on; event, button and input_button entities ring on every new event or press.
data_description.gong_entity: Switch entity that is turned on for the configured chime duration when the doorbell rings, e.g. a relay. Leave empty if no chime should be driven.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.description:
**Webhook URL:**
`{webhook_url}`

Enter this URL in the doorbell button as the action on press. Any device that calls an HTTP address when the button is pressed works, e.g. Shelly Gen1 ("I/O URL actions"), Shelly Gen2 and newer ("Actions" or "Webhooks"), ESPHome (http_request) or Tasmota (WebSend). HTTP on the local network only; the webhook cannot be reached from the internet. The URL is also shown later in the doorbell options.

data.restrict_ip: Accept webhook only from specific devices
data.allowed_sources: Allowed devices (IP addresses or host names)

data_description.restrict_ip: Recommended: webhook calls from other devices are rejected. Protects against false alarms from the network.
data_description.allowed_sources: Comma-separated list, e.g. 192.168.1.50, doorbell.local. Required when the restriction is on. Host names are resolved when the doorbell is loaded.

error.no_trigger: Please enable the webhook or select at least one trigger entity.
error.camera_in_use: This camera already belongs to another doorbell. Each camera can be used only once.
error.invalid_source: At least one entry is neither a valid IP address nor a valid host name.
error.source_required: Please enter at least one IP address or host name, or turn the restriction off.

create_entry.default:
The doorbell is set up.

**Webhook URL** ("—" = webhook disabled):
{webhook_hint}

The URL and all settings can be viewed or changed at any time in the doorbell options. Then let the HomeKit accessory be created under *Settings → System → Repairs*.

confirm.title: Create HomeKit accessory
confirm.description:
A dedicated HomeKit accessory (mode "accessory") is created for the camera {camera_entity_id}. The HomeKit Bridge links this device's doorbell automatically: Apple devices such as HomePod and iPhone announce the ring, the iPhone shows the camera picture.

Afterwards enter the pairing code from the notification in the Home app.

abort.already_exists: A HomeKit accessory already exists for {camera_entity_id}.
abort.camera_missing: The camera entity {camera_entity_id} is not available yet. Please try again later.
abort.homekit_failed: The HomeKit accessory could not be created automatically. Please create it manually: Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → HomeKit Bridge; then in the options of this new bridge select mode "accessory" and the camera {camera_entity_id}. See the README for details.

gong_waehlen.title: Select the chime switch for {name}
gong_waehlen.description:
After the update to version 0.2.0 no chime switch could be assigned automatically to the doorbell {name}. Please select a switch entity in the doorbell options under "Chime switch", e.g. the relay from the Shelly, ESPHome or Zigbee integration, or leave the field empty if no chime should be driven.

This notice disappears when the options are saved. Afterwards – or if no chime is wanted – it can also simply be ignored or dismissed.
